pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobated polygons with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level transitions. The individual dark contiguous regions exhibit a star-like or jagged geometry rather than rounded edges. Spatial area of patches is largest on the upper flank, becoming progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior and lower legs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A high-density topological graph of light-cream pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial intersections. The pathways maintain a consistent, narrow pixel thickness with high continuity across the mid-flank and shoulder regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck, characteristic of a short, erect mane. The serration frequency is dense and regular along the visible upper neck section.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized, dark-pigmented silhouette with a distinct avian morphology (consistent with an oxpecker) is present on the upper dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.
